title: Generic simplicity for self-adjoint operators under bounded potential perturbations
summary: We are interested in the generic simplicity of the spectrum of self-adjoint operators under bounded potential perturbations. More precisely, given a semibounded self-adjoint operator with compact resolvent and a suitable space of real-valued bounded perturbations, we study whether all eigenvalues of the perturbed operator are simple for a generic choice of the potential. In the first part of this paper we prove an abstract criterion which ensures that the set of perturbations giving only simple eigenvalues is residual.
